_meta.note: The salinity monitor's strings, merged over layer zero's pack at load. Every key starts with `salinity.`; `salinity.crop.*` are crop names, said in the reader's language inside a message.

strings.salinity.over: Salt in {bed} has reached about {ece:.1f} dS/m, as a saturated paste's extract would read, past the {threshold:.1f} at which the yield of {crop} starts to fall: about {loss:.0f}% of it is lost at this level. Water deeply to wash it below the roots, or uncover the bed to the winter's rain, and have the soil tested.
strings.salinity.rising: Salt in {bed} is climbing: about {ece:.1f} dS/m, as a saturated paste's extract would read, {share:.0f}% of the {threshold:.1f} at which the yield of {crop} starts to fall.
